title: UFC 333 video: Alexander Volkanovski, Movsar Evloev make weight for title fight
text:
UFC 333 weigh-in video: Alexander Volkanovski vs. Movsar Evloev official Videos Blue Corner Schedule Results Rankings Fighters A.S. 1980-2025 💙 Newsletter UFC UFC 333 video: Alexander Volkanovski, Movsar Evloev make weight for title fight
 Mike Bohn MMA Junkie Updated Oct. 23, 2026, 2:52 a.m. ET ABU DHABI – The UFC 333 main event title fight is locked in after Alexander Volkanovski and Movsar Evloev did their jobs on the scale at official weigh-ins.
 Volkanovski (28-4 MMA, 15-3 UFC) will put his featherweight belt on the line for the second time Saturday against undefeated contender Evloev (20-0 MMA, 10-0 UFC) at Etihad Arena on Yas Island ( Paramount+ ).
 Before stepping into the octagon, both men were required to step on the scale at the host hotel. Volkanovski registered at 144.5 pounds on the scale, while Evloev was 145 pounds ahead of his first title bid.
 Check out the video above to see the Volkanovski vs. Evloev official weigh-in highlights for UFC 333.
